title: Proposals
description: Assistants suggest changes. You decide what becomes part of your week.
loadError: Unable to load proposals. Check the companion connection.
stale: Your planner changed. Ask for a fresh proposal using the current revision.
invalid: This proposal cannot be applied. Request a new proposal.
overGoal: This change goes over a category goal.
decisionError: The decision could not be saved. Reload before trying again.
durabilityWarning: The change committed, but disk durability or proposal status needs a check. Keep the companion running and reload before retrying.
discardOnCancel: If you cancel, these changes are discarded and your plan stays as it is.
keepOnCancel: If you cancel, the proposal stays pending in Proposals.
duplicateCategory: You already have a category called “{name}”. Ask for a proposal that uses it.
emptyCategory: “{name}” will be empty; you can delete it in Settings.

history.earlierFooter: This proposal is from an earlier version; ask for a new one.
history.unreadableFooter: Weeklid cannot read this data and never applies it. You can save it as it is.
